verdict.rationale: Attio's App SDK documents bulk record actions that appear when several record rows are selected, and object actions for object-wide work such as imports and syncs. Bulk operations are therefore possible, but only through extensions a developer builds. Workflows that run plays on every account and AI-driven record updates hint at multi-record automation without explicitly documenting bulk execution. Missing for 10: documented native bulk edit/update in the UI, bulk or batch REST API endpoints, explicit AI-driven bulk updates across many records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
